note: GH.17 process managers (legacy-only, no matrix cell: binding a start to code is GH.18's host-start rules). A Procfile's `<type>: <command>` lines are INFRA_RESOURCEs `infra:process:<type>@<dir>` (the Procfile's repo-relative dir, as web / worker repeat per sub-project), each with a CODE start cell (host procfile, trigger process_type, the command and its effective argv ["/bin/sh", "-c", command]); a systemd `*.service` with a [Service] section is `infra:unit:<stem>`, its ExecStart (prefixes such as `-` stripped, split with shell-word rules; ExecStartPre / ExecReload are no start) the start cell (host systemd, trigger boot, WorkingDirectory as workdir); a supervisord conf's `[program:<n>]` sections are `infra:program:<n>` (host supervisor, trigger supervised, directory= as workdir). deploy/README.service has no [Service] section and mints nothing (`[proc-start] .. gated_out=1`). Before GH.17: none of these files was walked, no node and no marker.
